info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official AWS Account API (2021-02-01). Every other official operation returns HTTP 501 UnknownOperationException. The BILLING, OPERATIONS and SECURITY alternate contacts of the standalone simulator account are stored metadata: no email, call or notification is ever sent to them and the address and phone number are not verified. Each contact type is authorized as arn:aws:account::000000000000:account/alternate-contact/<TYPE> because the engine stores one resource per contact, so IAM policies that name the official account ARN need a trailing wildcard to match. AccountId is refused because the simulator account is not in an organization; contact information, account names, primary email, Region opt-in and Region listing return UnknownOperationException with HTTP 501.
info.title: AWS Account Management (simulator catalog)
